# Creative Commons

> Creative Commons provides free, legal tools and licenses to share creative works and build a global open knowledge movement.

Creative Commons is a nonprofit organization that enables creators, educators, and institutions to share their work openly. The site offers interactive license choosers, a multi-platform content search portal, professional certification programs, and resources for open licensing, open education, and data governance in the AI era.

## Key Topics

- CC BY 4.0 License
- CC BY 2.0 License
- CC PDM 1.0 (Public Domain Mark)
- Open Access
- Open Licensing
- Open Education
- Open Culture
- AI Governance
- Data Governance
- Knowledge Sharing
- Global Network
- Open Infrastructure
- Digital Commons
- Creative Works
- Nonprofit Organization

## Core Mission & About

- [Homepage - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org): Creative Commons homepage showcasing mission, licenses, and global open knowledge movement
- [Who We Are - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/about/mission): Creative Commons mission statement and organizational overview
- [What We Do - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/about): CC licenses, Global Network, Certificate, and Open Culture Program overview
- [Who We Are - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/mission): Creative Commons mission, vision, and organizational strategy

## License Tools & Resources

- [Chooser - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/choose): Interactive license chooser tool for CC0, BY, BY-SA, BY-ND licenses
- [Deed - Attribution 4.0 International - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0): Legal deed for CC Attribution 4.0 International license
- [Deed - Attribution 2.0 Generic - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0): Legal deed for CC Attribution 2.0 Generic license (older version)
- [Deed - Public Domain Mark 1.0 Universal - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0): Legal deed for Public Domain Mark 1.0 Universal designation
- [Share your work - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work): Guide to licensing and sharing work with Creative Commons tools

## Search & Discovery

- [CC Search Portal](https://search.creativecommons.org): Multi-platform search portal for CC-licensed content across Flickr, Europeana

## Education & Certification

- [CC Certificate Program - Creative Commons](https://certificate.creativecommons.org): Professional training certificates for open licensing and education

## Community & Events

- [Homepage - Creative Commons](https://summit.creativecommons.org): Creative Commons Summit event homepage and information
- [Blog - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/blog): News, stories, interviews on CC work, licenses, programs, and community
- [AI's Infrastructure Era: Reflections from the AI Impact Summit in Delhi - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/2026/03/04/ais-infrastructure-era): AI Impact Summit Delhi reflections on AI governance and data equity
- [CC Hosts Open Heritage Statement Event in Amsterdam - Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/2026/03/06/open-heritage-statement-event-amsterdam-march-2026): Event recap on Netherlands heritage collections digitization and open access
